description: With the same test pack, a player who knows only bbb:same_mix (aaa:same_mix comes first and takes the same grid) places it from the recipe book at a crafting table and in the own window, once and as many as fit, with doLimitedCrafting off and on, and takes the results; the placed recipe's birch log at the table until the grid changes, the first recipe's oak log in the own window; Circuit and both official servers give the same windows, logs and recipes (those unlocked at once compared as sets: their order varies on the official servers)
